source.directorySummary: Implements bottomup.generate for one-directory structured knowledge via command definition, CLI/web adaptation and stateless draft revision/acceptance, coding-agent session orchestration, and handler-driven option normalization, planning, hash-based cache reuse, inherited context resolution and recursive coverage tracking, supported by workspace-safe filesystem utilities for path resolution, generate-root lookup, filtered listing, SHA-256 hashing, index parsing/serialization with atomic writes, truncated source reading, and shared constants/schemas/types, with tests for snippet and handler behavior.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapts CLI and web options into bottomup.generate calls and renders web drafts or formatted text results.

ai.ts.sourceSummary: Runs fresh or continued plugin coding-agent sessions to produce and validate structured one-directory JSON knowledge.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines the public bottomup.generate command and hidden stateless draft revise and accept subcommands.

draft-adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Handles web-only stateless draft revision and acceptance via encoded state validation.

fs.test.ts.sourceSummary: Tests readSourceSnippet for within-budget pass-through, middle truncation preserving head and tail with marker under 24 KB, and null-byte detection returning null.

fs.ts.sourceSummary: Provides workspace-safe path and generate-root resolution with symlink checks, filtered entry listing, SHA-256 hashing, index parsing/serialization with atomic writes, and source snippet reading with 24 KB middle truncation and null-byte handling plus direct file hashing.

handler.test.ts.sourceSummary: Tests registration, planning, generation, cache reuse, recursive enrichment, drafts, handoff, and path safety.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Orchestrates option normalization/validation, plan building, hash-based cache reuse, inherited context resolution, one-level and recursive generation with child coverage tracking, and base64url-encoded stateless draft revise/accept validation.

types.ts.sourceSummary: Defines BOTTOMUP index constants and Zod schemas for file, child, context, enrichment, summary and index records, AI response validation, and types for resolved options, plans, results, and encoded draft state.

summary.value: plugins/file/commands/bottomup-generate implements `bottomup.generate` for one-directory structured knowledge via command definition with CLI/web adaptation, stateless draft revision/acceptance, and coding-agent session orchestration. Handler layer normalizes options, plans execution, resolves inherited context, reuses cache via SHA-256 hashing, and tracks recursive coverage; supported by workspace-safe filesystem utilities for path resolution, generate-root lookup, filtered listing, hashing, index parsing/serialization with atomic writes, and truncated source reading, plus shared constants/schemas/types and snippet/handler tests. Child `renderers/` (complete) renders the draft web modal with diffPatch preview and Accept/Decline workflow controls. Coverage is complete for this directory and its immediate child with no missing or stale generated summaries.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Leaf generation engine within the bottom-up knowledge pipeline family under plugins/file/commands. Owns the single-directory structured-knowledge lifecycle (vs. sibling summarize/enrich/summary commands) and concretizes the shared bottom-up pattern — inherited-context resolution, SHA-256 hash-cache reuse, one-level/recursive coverage tracking, and stateless draft revise/accept — behind the centralized file dispatcher (adapter.ts/handleFile). Handler orchestrates the flow while delegating coding-agent execution to ai.ts, workspace-safe I/O to fs.ts, contract validation to types.ts, and modal diff/accept UI to child renderers/.

files.adapter.ts: Public boundary for this subcommand — normalizes CLI vs web option shapes into handler contracts and selects output branch (formatted CLI text vs. draft modal via renderers/), completing the validate → execute → adapt flow for bottomup.generate.
files.ai.ts: Isolated coding-agent execution layer invoked by handler — decouples fresh/continued plugin coding-agent session management and structured JSON validation from planning, caching, and persistence logic.
files.definition.ts: Declarative registration surface consumed by the file plugin init/dispatcher — exposes public bottomup.generate and hidden stateless revise/accept subcommands and binds their schemas to adapter/handler without owning execution.
files.draft-adapter.ts: Web-only stateless continuation controller — validates base64url-encoded draft state handed off from handler/renderers modal and re-enters the ai/handler revise or accept path without server-side session persistence.
files.fs.ts: Workspace-safe filesystem substrate for the generation flow — encapsulates symlink-checked path/generate-root resolution, filtered listing, SHA-256 hashing, atomic index parse/serialize, and 24KB-truncated snippet reading used by handler and ai.ts.
files.handler.ts: Central orchestrator for the directory — normalizes/validates options, builds plans, resolves inherited context, decides hash-based cache reuse, drives one-level/recursive generation with child coverage tracking, and encodes/validates stateless draft handoff for revise/accept.
files.types.ts: Single contract hub for the directory — defines BOTTOMUP constants, Zod schemas (file/child/context/enrichment/summary/index + AI response), and resolved-option/plan/result/draft-state types shared by definition, handler, ai, fs, and renderers.
